page: Google Cloud Platform e2-highmem-2 is a memory-optimized cloud server powered by an Intel Xeon x86_64 processor operating at 2.2 GHz. The instance features 2 virtual CPUs derived from a single physical core with hyperthreading enabled, paired with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The processor features 16 MB of L3 cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and supports x86 instruction extensions including AVX, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA. It lacks dedicated local NVMe storage and discrete GPU accelerators.

Synthetic compute and memory benchmarks indicate limited processing throughput suitable primarily for light workloads. Single-core performance evaluated via stress-ng achieved 1101.98, while multi-core stress-ng reached 1451.88. Geekbench scores recorded 841.0 for single-core and 1028.0 for multi-core tasks. Uncached 256MB memory bandwidth yielded 12.0 GB/sec for read operations and 10.51 GB/sec for write operations, with a PassMark memory rating of 1468.27.

Application-level performance testing shows Redis SET throughput reaching 1.33 million operations per second and static web serving throughput at 1.43 GB/sec. Small 135M parameter LLM text generation attained 61.66 tokens per second. The resource profile provides favorable cost efficiency for workloads requiring moderate RAM density without heavy CPU demand, though low compute and memory bandwidth cap high-concurrency capability. Workload suitability includes lightweight cache servers, small in-memory databases, background worker nodes, and basic web applications.
description: Google Cloud Platform e2-highmem-2 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring an Intel Xeon x86_64 CPU running at 2.2 GHz with 2 vCPUs across 1 physical core and 16.0 GB of memory. Delivering 8.0 GB of RAM per virtual core and 16 MB of L3 cache, this instance caters to memory-centric applications that demand low compute overhead. Benchmark evaluations reflect modest processing capacity, recording a Geekbench multi-core score of 1028.0, an uncached memory read bandwidth of 12.0 GB/sec, and Redis SET throughput of 1.33 million operations per second. The instance includes no local storage or GPU hardware. The high ratio of memory relative to vCPU allocation delivers qualitative resource efficiency for light memory-bound services without paying for unneeded CPU cores. Recommended workloads encompass small in-memory key-value stores, lightweight databases, staging environments, and low-traffic web applications.

tagline: An entry-level memory-optimized virtual machine offering sixteen gigabytes of RAM paired with two virtual cores for lightweight memory-centric background applications.
bullet_points: Configured with 2 vCPUs across 1 physical core and 16.0 GB RAM (8.0 GB per core).
Powered by a 2.2 GHz Intel Xeon x86_64 processor with 16 MB L3 cache.
Delivers 1.33 million Redis SET operations per second and 12.0 GB/sec uncached memory read bandwidth.
Lacks attached local NVMe storage and discrete GPU acceleration hardware.
Well suited for lightweight in-memory caches, small databases, and background tasks.
